properties.notes: Land north of the former Chapelcross nuclear site. APRS reports the planning application was validated on 28 September 2026, with an EIA.
properties.model_bbox_note: 3.2 × 1.6 km (east–west × north–south), moved 0.7 km north of the APRS-pin default so the whole application red line and every drawn building fit (JC, 26 Nov 2026); the pin stays inside. A modelling extent, not a site boundary.
